text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, August 10, 2018 Posted by admin on August 10th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL), Nike (NKE) and UnitedHealth (UNH). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -120 points.
Thursday the Dow was down -74.52 (-0.29%) at 25,509.23.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +3.20%.
There were 14 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by DowDuPont (DWDP) +2.01% and UnitedHealth (UNH) +1.07%
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Procter & Gamble (PG) -1.15% and 3M (MMM) -1.14%.
Intel (INTC +0.36%) was downgraded to ‘Sell’ from ‘Neutral’ at Goldman Sachs with a price target of $44.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down two-tenths of a cent at $2.867 per gallon.
